paragraphs: Welcome to Mid Valley Storage, Visalia’s best choice for convenient, safe, and affordable self storage. We pride ourselves with our friendly and professional customer service, state of the art security, and convenient locations.

We aim to become Visalia area’s premier and feature rich self storage facility. Whether you’re looking for a place to store your boat or RV after a camping or lake trip or looking to organize items from around the home or office, Mid Valley Storage does it all. Attentive detail without compromise can be seen throughout the facility from the moment the gate keypad recognizes your name and unit number, to the sophisticated temperature controlled units, well lit and video monitored RV and boat parking, and complete moving supply center in the office. Features aside, Mid Valley Storage has only one focus: the complete 110% satisfaction of its customers.

Exterior drive-up units, interior drive-up units, small units, big, units – Mid Valley Storage has them all! With sizes from 5×5 to 20×50, we’ve got the perfect space just for you! It’s the perfect spot to store you extra items and get your garage back. Call us today and our professional staff can help you find the perfect size just for you.

Scorching hot summers and cold foggy winters are no problem for our interior temperature controlled units. Cool air conditioning in the summer and warm heat in the winter – all in a interior dust free environment. Perfect for electronics, music equipment, antiques, documents, and so much more!

With three National Parks nearby, numerous lakes, and the beach a few hours away – we know how great it is to hit the road in your RV, boat, or trailer. We have indoor, privately enclosed units with oversized doors perfect for your toys! All oversized units have the option of adding power and lights, perfect for keeping your battery charged before your next trip!

Whether you need to store your holiday decorations in the off season or store your entire house during a move, our goal is to exceed your expectations! We provide secure, convenient, and spotlessly clean storage units from small 5×5 to large 20×50 in RV units. Call us today to speak with one of our friendly professional managers who can assist in choosing the perfect storage size just for you
